name: orca-project-delivery
revisionNote: In-place remediation released as 1.1.0 (findings F1-F20 in orca-project-delivery-remediation-plan.md); the follow-up batch released as 1.1.1 puts claude first in every role route, corrects the claude tiers against Orca's per-model option catalog, and adds two harness checks. See CHANGELOG.md for the per-wave list; the inPlaceFixes block below records the earlier 1.0.0 in-place pass.

inPlaceFixes.scripts/assemble-task.ps1: 1.0.0 pass: parse error (escaped closing quote) and literal placeholders in the assembled assignment. Heading levels and role front matter were finalised in the 1.1.0 pass (F13).
inPlaceFixes.scripts/bootstrap-project.ps1: Detached HEAD validated before any write; coordinator lock records the Orca terminal handle and applies a live/dead/unknown liveness rule.
inPlaceFixes.scripts/create-run.ps1: Detached HEAD validated before any write; failures roll back a partially created run directory; -Force archives prior state; delivery branch resolved from the repository default and recorded with its source.
inPlaceFixes.scripts/release-coordinator.ps1: New: refuses without -ConfirmRunClosed, archives active-run/lock, marks the lock released, reports reclaimable workers best-effort.
inPlaceFixes.scripts/validate-run.ps1: New: schema validation of manifest/lock/active-run/run-state/assignments plus templates, run invariants (3, 1, lock divergence, delivery branch), duplicate-authority drift, routing order, and declared-skill existence.
inPlaceFixes.scripts/reconcile-state.ps1: Exact branch/worktree matching instead of substring matching.
inPlaceFixes.scripts/probe-agent-capabilities.ps1: Manifest guard, timeout and shim-safe CLI probing, and per-profile model/effort evidence in .dev-work/runtime/model-capabilities.json.
inPlaceFixes.schemas: Added active-run, task-definition and coordinator-lock schemas; templates now validate.
inPlaceFixes.routing/agent-selection.json, agents/rol: Profiles with autoRouteAfterProbe=false no longer precede auto-routeable profiles.
inPlaceFixes.agents/skill-loading.json, adapters/skil: Claude provider alias marked unverified (path absent on this host); explicit-path is the default.
inPlaceFixes.SKILL.md, adapters, references, template: Worker input order unified at 10 sections; outcome vocabulary mapped to worker_done --outcome; failure taxonomy mapped to Orca evidence; coordinator lock documented.
